svg.text: CaseLens: Fan-Pattern Compliance Prototype (Scenario Studio + Investigation Agents)
YOUR WINDOWS LAPTOP (runs directly, only MongoDB is in Docker)
Quality checks run after each layer. Size guard stops loading if MongoDB passes 1 GB.
INVESTIGATION GRAPH (LangGraph, fixed flow, not a free-roaming agent)
If the checker rejects the draft: retry the drafter once, then mark needs_human_rewrite.
Token budget guard refuses AI calls when the free-credit budget is used up.
IAM least privilege (Bedrock + one S3 bucket)
